purpose: Hierarchical wayfinding trail showing the ancestor path of the current page with the final entry marked as aria-current; on a phone, a back link chosen in CSS on the first paint.
useWhen: Surfacing where the user sits inside a deep, nested hierarchy.
Letting the user jump back to any ancestor view in one click.
A server-rendered page that must paint its phone form before script runs: both forms are in the server HTML, and CSS exposes one at a time.

avoidWhen.reason: Switching between sibling sections at the same level — use navigation-bar or tabs.
Showing an ordered task progression — use steps instead.
